notes: The ASV writes one *unto them*; the first `לָהֶם` is the rendered occurrence inside the relative clause and the second is the unrendered one (rule 22).
`דּוֹר שְׁלִישִׁי` takes the supplied *of* as an adverbial accusative (rule 33) and the supplied determiner on the noun rather than the ordinal (rule 15).
